people.name: Bilhah
people.line: Rachel's maidservant and mother of Dan and Naphtali

people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

translations.web: Laban gave Bilhah, his servant, to his daughter Rachel to be her servant.
translations.bsb: Laban also gave his servant girl Bilhah to his daughter Rachel as her maidservant.
translations.kjv: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.
translations.asv: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her handmaid.
